title: ADR-0159 revision: record the major-release rulings (one major, convert then switch, internal forms removed, release-note warning, HotCRM with its bump)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Source: ruling record 7142585849 on #36868 (2026-11-24T19:46Z), which records four maintainer rulings and two seat decisions made after ADR-0159 merged (PR #36957). Parent: #36868. This card revises the text of `docs/adr/0159-forms-are-their-own-metadata-type-public-forms-are-form-items-view-is-lists-only.md` that those rulings contradict.

Metadata-protocol: none
Clause-②: no

Grading: `area:build` · Docs (ADR revision) · ADR-0159 says what the rulings of 7142585849 decided, so the cards cut from it and the record agree · the seats and dev agents that read the record · evidence: the sentences quoted below, read at `main` `254e396a29e`. p1: cards ⑤a and ⑤b are built against the revised text.

Governed surface: `docs/adr/**` is Tier H. Push, open the PR, and stop: ⛔ no AI seat merges, queues or arms auto-merge on it; the maintainer merges by hand. `domain:skills`. It waits on no card and can land now.

## The rulings, verbatim (1–4 in 7142585849; 5 in its addendum 7142658348)

1. 「卡⑤ 不用暂缓，下一个版本就是大版本」
2. 「B：全部放进下一个大版本，升级命令先自动转换、再切换」
3. 「B（fable 推荐）：升级时自动删除。」
4. 「要在发版说明里重点提示」
5. On HotCRM, the maintainer verbatim (addendum 7142658348): 「HotCRM 的迁移跟着它升级到大版本那次一起做」「卡⑤ 不再等 HotCRM 卡，否则两边会互相等待。」

Seat decisions the record carries (maintainer veto window): the upgrade's move is all-or-nothing with the switch (7142585849); the ceremony's `--apply` is reached only from the upgrade command, and the standalone command is read-only (7142658348). The major-19 card not waiting on the HotCRM card is ruling 5, no longer a seat decision.

⛔ Nothing else in ADR-0159 is re-opened. The five merge questions, D6's rules, D7-a, D7-b, D7-d, D7-e and the later ruling 7136809727 stand as written.

## What to revise

Each revision cites `7142585849` beside the changed sentence, with the ruling's number. Keep the record's own convention: the ruled words verbatim and untranslated, and anything that is the seat's or the record's own reading marked as such, outside the ruled text. Add a dated line to the Status paragraph and to "Decided by", and one TL;DR entry that names the four changes below.

**A. Release sequencing (rulings 1 and 2).** There is no release between today's and major 19 that carries the `form` type. Every card ships in the major.

| Where | Sentence on `main` | Revise to say |
|:--|:--|:--|
| TL;DR 3; D5, opening line | "From the release that adds it until the next protocol major, the loader projects the three old shapes into `form` items" / "From the release that adds the type until the next protocol major" | The release that adds the type is major 19. The dual-read exists on `main` between the cards' merges and in no release; after the major the projection serves no content and only the kept reader and rule 11's check remain (D7, "After the major", unchanged). |
| D5 | "`view` reads are unchanged until the major", "Old-shape writes still save until the major", "No conversion notice and no new warning for an old shape before the major" | True of each card's change on `main`, and of no release: say so in one sentence under the three bullets. Do not delete the rules; the cards are still built to them so each merge leaves `main` working. |
| D8 | the `_views` form tails "are read when `forms.NAME` has no value for the key, until major 19" | No release reads the fallback; it exists on `main` between card ② and the major-19 card. |
| D7, Schedule | "tombstoned in **major 19** and not before" | Unchanged, plus: the type is added in the same major. |
| Execution plan, table and bullets | "② is one releasable change"; "⑤ is cut only when the maintainer opens major 19"; "(HotCRM's waits for a release that carries both)" | ② is one landable change; ⑤ is not held (ruling 1) and is cut now as two cards, the ceremony with the precheck report, and the major; the rows of the table gain the skills card split from ④. |
| Consequences | "Until major 19 there are two readers of form content"; "The anonymous doors read two types for at least one major" | Both readers exist on `main` only until the major-19 card; the doors keep the second type's withdrawal reader after it, as D7-f says. |

**B. The ceremony runs inside the upgrade command, and the move is all-or-nothing with the switch (ruling 2; seat decision).**

| Where | Sentence on `main` | Revise to say |
|:--|:--|:--|
| D7, "Stored rows" | "a CLI ceremony the administrator runs, read-only by default, `--apply` to write, idempotent, reporting per package what it moved and what it could not" | The major's upgrade command runs it: convert first, then switch. An administrator can take the read-only run before upgrading; the write is reached only from the upgrade command. Idempotent and per-package reporting stand. |
| D7 | "The ceremony can be run from the release that adds the type. It **must** be run before a deployment moves to major 19: that release's upgrade refuses to proceed while a stored old-shape form row exists" | The upgrade command runs the ceremony and then the precheck; it switches when the precheck counts no row and refuses to switch when it counts one, naming each row and its action. The deployment stays on the release it is running. |
| D7, new paragraph, marked as a seat decision | (none) | A deployment that does not switch holds every stored row as it was. The pre-upgrade release has no `form` type and reads `view` rows only, so a switch-off moved to a `form` row there is read by nothing and the base's form answers. Rests on ruled question 4. |
| D7-c | "It stays a `view` row, still read by rules 4, 7 and 11 of D6" ; "The administrator makes it and runs the ceremony with `--apply` again" ; "the deployment stays on major 18 until the App ships a version without the cause" ; "It leaves the class by an old-shape save that repairs the body, which saves until the major" | The row stays a `view` row on the pre-upgrade release, which reads it as it does today (that release has no D6). The administrator removes the cause there and runs the upgrade command again. The repair save is made on that release. "Stays on major 18" stands and is this state. |
| D6 rule 7 | "the boot says so once at `error`, naming the row and the ceremony of D7" | Names the row, the links it closed and the repair; the ceremony's name once the ceremony card has landed. |
| Consequences | "A deployment must run a ceremony before major 19, and that upgrade refuses without it." | The upgrade runs it; the upgrade refuses to switch only for a row it cannot move. |

**C. Stored internal record forms are removed by the upgrade (ruling 3).**

| Where | Sentence on `main` | Revise to say |
|:--|:--|:--|
| D7, "Stored rows" | "Internal record forms in stored rows are reported and left for the administrator to remove … The ceremony deletes nothing it did not move." | The upgrade removes them in the run that switches: an item-shaped row is deleted, a container that also holds lists is re-saved without the member, its lists byte-equal. The report names each removed form, writes out its body, and says per object that New and Edit now follow the object's field groups and whether it has any. History rows stay verbatim. A deployment that does not switch keeps every one. |
| D7, same bullet | "The precheck counts the internal ones like any other old-shape form row and names them with that action." | The precheck does not count them as holding the upgrade; the read-only run lists them as "will be removed". |
| D7 | "that release's upgrade refuses to proceed while a stored old-shape form row exists — one the ceremony can still move, an internal record form, or a row that holds the upgrade" | Drop "an internal record form" and "one the ceremony can still move" from what refuses: the upgrade moves the one and removes the other. What refuses is a row that holds the upgrade (D7-c). |
| D7, "Security pins card ⑤ owes", "the precheck refuses" | "a stored old-shape form row of each class (movable, internal, pair not ensurable, body not readable) does not reach major 19" | Stopping classes are pair not ensurable and body not readable. Add the pin the ruling's conditions need: internal forms are removed and only those; a row with a link, or over a linked base, in the same slot is not. |
| D7-e and the internal set's three-part test | — | ⛔ Unchanged. Say in one sentence that ruling 3 widens nothing: a row that declares a `sharing.publicLink`, or stands over a linked base, is never removed. |
| The table "What keeps a public address closed today", "Precheck" column | D7-e cells | Unchanged; add a footnote that the upgrade's removal never reaches any row of the table. |

**D. Release notes (ruling 4).** Add to the Execution plan, on the major-19 card: its changeset's BREAKING section leads with #36425's customer-visible effect, because that change now reaches customers in the same release: New and Edit lay out by the object's field groups; a form's sections, tabs, wizard steps, create defaults and form-level required rules stop applying; nothing converts them.

**E. HotCRM (ruling 5, 7142658348).**

| Where | Sentence on `main` | Revise to say |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Execution plan, table | ⑤ "Blocked by ③ and ④" | ⑤ is blocked by ③ and this repository's half of ④; it does not wait on the HotCRM card. |
| Execution plan, ④ bullet | "After ④ no first-party source authors an old shape, which is what lets ⑤ measure 'zero first-party' before it tombstones." | The reading covers this repository. HotCRM moves its sources in the same change as its bump to the major. |

## Done when

- Every row above is revised in the record, each with `7142585849` and the ruling's number beside it; the rulings are quoted verbatim and untranslated.
- The Status paragraph and "Decided by" carry the dated line; the TL;DR names the four changes.
- No ruled block of the five merge questions is edited; `git diff` shows no change inside D6's rules 1 to 11, D7-a, D7-b, D7-d or the later-ruling paragraph beside question 4.
- `pnpm check:adr-anchors` and the ADR index and link checks `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` names for this file are green.
- The PR body names #37086, #37087, #37088 and the cards filed as ⑤a and ⑤b as the readers of the revised text, and is left awaiting the maintainer's merge.

## Not in this card

- No code, schema or changeset.
- No new decision. A sentence the rulings do not reach is not touched; a contradiction found that is not in the tables above is reported, not resolved.
- ADR-0017, ADR-0146 and ADR-0150 are not edited here.

Dedupe words: ADR-0159 revision, release sequencing major 19, internal record forms removed by upgrade, all-or-nothing switch.
